de1.P4.C7.ghi_chu: Y a kiem chung dung (tu giac ABOC noi tiep, AO la trung truc cua BC nen BC vuong goc AO). Y b chua ket luan duoc: khung khang dinh goc AEB = goc ABD voi ly do 'gia thiet' la khong co co so, va de bai dinh nghia E la giao cua CD voi (O) trong khi C, D deu da nam tren (O) (suy ra E trung D) - co the de goc ghi khac; ket luan AB^2 = BE . BD cung sai trong cac truong hop thu (voi E = D thi no doi AB = BD). Y c khong kiem chung duoc: de chi ghi 'Tinh toan do dai va ban kinh' ma khong noi ro tinh doan nao, nen R can 3 khong co co so. Can de goc.
